rationale: itnet-claude-agentic: pretrain_epochs=30, pretrain_lr=0.001, itnet_k=1, itnet_alpha=0.0, unet_c=16, finetune_epochs=0, finetune_lr=0.0001, train_n=1600, val_n=200, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, rationale=iter-9 (breast ItNet v1). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: iter-5 (tn400,ep120) 0.8741; iter-8 (tn800,ep60, compute-matched 48000 steps) 0.8842 NEW BEST (+0.010). CONFIRMED: at equal compute, 2x MORE scene DIVERSITY helps -> denoiser was DATA-diversity-limited, not compute-limited. (2) FAILURE MODE: keep pushing the winning lever until diversity saturates. (3) ONE KNOB (from champion iter-8): train_n 800 -> 1600, with pretrain_epochs 60 -> 30 so 1600x30 = 48000 grad steps = SAME compute (epoch cut is pure compute-normalization). All else = iter-8 (k1,a0.0,c16,lr1e-3,val200). (4) HYPOTHESIS: if I double scene diversity again at fixed compute, I expect hr above 0.8842 (continuing the 0.8741->0.8842 diversity slope) because the breast-phantom distribution is still under-covered at 800 scenes. FALSIFIER: if hr<=0.8842, diversity saturates around 800-1600 scenes at fixed 48000 steps -> the ceiling shifts to COMPUTE (more total grad steps) or CAPACITY -> iter-10 raises total steps (more epochs at the best train_n, budget permitting) or width. (5) BUDGET: 48000 grad steps = iter-8s ~890s (turbo) < 20 min; each epoch now touches 1600 scenes but only 30 epochs. train_n=1600 <= 2400 FBP-safe cap. (6) Loop to iter-20.
